name: Autonomous Intelligence Newsroom
thesis: Build a Google News-style event aggregation and clustering product operated by the Factory, beginning with African business and economic intelligence and progressing toward autonomous opportunity detection.
reference_pattern: Google News aggregation and story clustering
differentiation: NEWS -> EVENT -> ECONOMIC SIGNIFICANCE -> COMPANIES/MARKETS AFFECTED -> OPPORTUNITY -> ACTION

prototype.purpose: Evaluate information architecture, user experience, event-cluster model and opportunity-action surface before live ingestion.

validation_gates: Connect a bounded set of legal/public sources
Prove economic-significance ranking adds value over a normal news feed
Generate at least five human-actionable opportunity hypotheses from live news
Estimate ongoing ingestion, model and hosting cost
Stress-test copyright, attribution and source-use policy
kill_criteria: Event clustering remains unreliable after bounded tuning
The intelligence layer produces no measurable advantage over commodity aggregation
Cost per useful qualified signal is economically unattractive
next_action: Review the UI prototype, then connect a controlled live source set and run the first news-to-opportunity validation cycle.
